name: Reviewer Dossier
description: Keeps a durable, per-repo record of what code reviewers actually flag and what we did about it: captured PR comments are classified into patterns, persisted into the project's Obsidian home keyed by canonical repo identity, and surfaced as an advisory line in the pre-PR checklist so a recurring finding is pre-empted before the PR goes out. Declines are recorded as first-class entries and arm the next protest reply rather than driving a code change.

dossierEnabled.label: Dossier Enabled
dossierEnabled.description: Master switch. When on, TPM classifies triaged PR comments into patterns, persists them, and surfaces matches as an advisory in the pre-PR checklist. When off, nothing is written or surfaced; existing entries stay on disk untouched.

captureFilePath.label: Capture File Path
captureFilePath.description: Absolute path to the PR-comment capture file that bb-bridge appends to. Injected by the host at compose time — not user-editable; any stored value is overwritten on every compose.

acceptThreshold.label: Accept Threshold
acceptThreshold.description: Accepted occurrences across this many DISTINCT pull requests required before a pattern can drive pre-emption (comments on one PR count once). Accepted-under-protest never counts toward this.

declineVetoDays.label: Decline Veto Days
declineVetoDays.description: A decline or accepted-under-protest within this many days vetoes the pattern outright, regardless of accept count. A veto, not a weighting.

stalePatternDays.label: Stale Pattern Days
stalePatternDays.description: A pattern with no new evidence for this many days is demoted to advisory-only — reportable as a note but can't block or drive a pre-emptive fix. Never deletes the entry.

maxSurfacedPatterns.label: Max Surfaced Patterns
maxSurfacedPatterns.description: Top-K cap on the pre-submit advisory. At most this many matched patterns are listed individually, highest confidence first; the rest collapse into one summary line.

briefInjection.label: Brief Injection
briefInjection.description: Whether accepted patterns are injected into SWE assignment briefs at write time. off (default): dossier is consulted only at pre-PR. matched-only: injects up to 3 patterns matching the assignment's files, one line each.
